component.name: OpenCIE
component.summary: Sign documents with the Italian CIE

description.p: OpenCIE is an open-source application for digital signatures, verification, and identity management with the Italian Electronic Identity Card (CIE — Carta d'Identità Elettronica).

ul.li: Sign — CAdES (.p7m), PAdES (PDF), and XAdES (.xml) digital signatures using the CIE chip
Verify — validate signatures with OCSP/CRL revocation checking
Manage — enroll and manage CIE cards, change or unblock the PIN

description.p: A PC/SC-compatible smart card or contactless reader is required to communicate with the card.

screenshot.caption: Sign documents with the CIE chip

description.p: Corrects the Windows installer, which was labelled with the previous version number.

ul.li: Fixed PIN entry on the signing screens, which capped input at 4 digits while the CIE PIN is 8.
Tokens and enrolled-card records are now stored encrypted in the system keyring instead of plain text.
Repeated wrong PIN entries are throttled, and PIN screens block screenshots and screen recording on Android.
Card failures now explain what went wrong and how to recover, instead of a generic error.
Card reading is announced to screen readers, and animations honour the reduced-motion setting.
Expired sign-in sessions are renewed silently instead of forcing a new login.

description.p: Initial release: CAdES/PAdES/XAdES signing, signature verification with OCSP/CRL, CIE card management.
